create_SubDataset: create a SubDataset with name, description, homepage, url, and languages to track OPUS sub-dataset information
build_OpusConfig: build an OpusConfig with language_pair and subsets for OPUS dataset builder configuration
build_Opus_Builder: build an OPUS dataset builder that downloads and generates parallel translation examples from OPUS corpora
test_Opus_Builder_splits: test the OPUS builder _split_generators method to download and extract language-specific translation files
summarize_Opus_Builder_generate: summarize the OPUS builder _generate_examples method that yields source-target sentence pairs from OPUS files
